subject: ddl, executor, statistics, planner: remove extended stats feature (#66362)
summary: Removes extended statistics end-to-end in the reviewed areas: planner no longer pulls extra ANALYZE columns or uses extended-stats-based correlation for limit rowcount adjustment; executor paths for `SHOW STATS_EXTENDED` and `ADMIN RELOAD STATS_EXTENDED` now fail with explicit "feature has been removed" errors while keeping parser syntax compatibility; statistics drops ExtendedStats data structures and stops building/saving/loading/extending stats via storage/JSON paths. `tidb_enable_extended_stats` remains as a hidden compatibility sysvar but has no remaining functional impact in planner/executor/statistics after this change.
